reasoning_content: Node is available. Let me sync the capacitor project to generate the gradle files.

action.command:
python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko
c = paramiko.SSHClient()
c.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
c.connect('46.202.154.25', 22, 'root', '2N00py123+++')

# Sync capacitor 
c.exec_command("""export JAVA_HOME=/usr/lib/jvm/java-17-openjdk-amd64
export ANDROID_HOME=~/android-sdk
export PATH=\\$JAVA_HOME/bin:\\$ANDROID_HOME/cmdline-tools/latest/bin:\\$ANDROID_HOME/platform-tools:\\$PATH
cd /opt/areloria/client
/usr/bin/npm install 2>&1 | tail -5
npx cap sync android 2>&1 | tail -10""")

# Check if gradlew was created
stdin, stdout, stderr = c.exec_command("ls -la /opt/areloria/client/android/")

print("Android folder:", stdout.read().decode())

c.close()
EOF
